t: You're on Grafton Way, a street in Camden that runs from Gower Street in the east to Fitzroy Street in the west, crossing Tottenham Court Road about halfway along. Whitfield Street and Grafton Mews join it. The name comes from Henry FitzRoy, the first Duke of Grafton, an illegitimate son of Charles the Second and his mistress Barbara Villiers. He was a military commander, colonel of the Grenadier Guards from 1681 and Vice-Admiral of England from 1682 to 1689. He was killed in 1690, in the storming of Cork.
